lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The Year of Two Skies comes round again.|Every ship. Every dragon. One strait.
lines.text: The Year of Two Skies comes round again. Every ship. Every dragon. One strait.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Today we finish Aurivane, Torvald.|Take the rock. I will handle the sky.
lines.text: Today we finish Aurivane, Torvald. Take the rock. I will handle the sky.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: You handled the Laurel too, Malrik.|I have not forgotten whose knives they were.
lines.text: You handled the Laurel too, Malrik. I have not forgotten whose knives they were.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then remember it after we win.|Victory is a wonderful eraser.
lines.text: Then remember it after we win. Victory is a wonderful eraser.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Crimson sails on the water. They will shell|the shore road. Sink them, or stay off it.
lines.text: Crimson sails on the water. They will shell the shore road. Sink them, or stay off it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Last chance to pick the right side,|Torvald! I'm told I'm very forgiving!
lines.text: Last chance to pick the right side, Torvald! I'm told I'm very forgiving!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: You are told many things, Vessa.|Most of them by people standing behind you.
lines.text: You are told many things, Vessa. Most of them by people standing behind you.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: One small sale before the great one.|Sunwake, Aurivane's pride. Who pays?
lines.text: One small sale before the great one. Sunwake, Aurivane's pride. Who pays?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Sunwake flies with us.|For the morning, at least.
lines.text: Sunwake flies with us. For the morning, at least.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Sunwake keeps her old masters. For now.
lines.text: Sunwake keeps her old masters. For now.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Malrik! Every grave you dig,|I will plant over. Every single one!
lines.text: Malrik! Every grave you dig, I will plant over. Every single one!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then you will be a very busy gardener, Ysolde.
lines.text: Then you will be a very busy gardener, Ysolde.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: One red sail under.|The sea keeps the coin, as usual.
lines.text: One red sail under. The sea keeps the coin, as usual.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The rock is Adamarch's! The Archon is watching|from the spire, Ice-king. So is everyone.
lines.text: The rock is Adamarch's! The Archon is watching from the spire, Ice-king. So is everyone.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: Empty the pits. All of them.|Let the sky be white and silver by noon.
lines.text: Empty the pits. All of them. Let the sky be white and silver by noon.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Every dragon on the Coinwater changes sides|in one morning. I have seen this before.
lines.text: Every dragon on the Coinwater changes sides in one morning. I have seen this before.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: He bought the whole SKY? Ysolde,|pull back! Everyone, back to the ships!
lines.text: He bought the whole SKY? Ysolde, pull back! Everyone, back to the ships!

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Enough. Seraphine, the cloth.|We end this on the sand, the old way.
lines.text: Enough. Seraphine, the cloth. We end this on the sand, the old way.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: A truce, Sunblade. No bets. No knives. Just us.
lines.text: A truce, Sunblade. No bets. No knives. Just us.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Burn them. Both fleets, the sand, the cloth.|A strait of dead feeds the stone for years.
lines.text: Burn them. Both fleets, the sand, the cloth. A strait of dead feeds the stone for years.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Yes, Bishop. A whole sea of them. Feed me,|and I will crown you king of the deep.
lines.text: Yes, Bishop. A whole sea of them. Feed me, and I will crown you king of the deep.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: No.
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: You said that once before,|in your hall. "For now," you said.
lines.text: You said that once before, in your hall. "For now," you said.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I am done waiting, Malrik.|Aldra. Everyone. To the rock.
lines.text: I am done waiting, Malrik. Aldra. Everyone. To the rock.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: You paid me once, Ice-king, in clean coin.|That bond still holds. I fly with you.
lines.text: You paid me once, Ice-king, in clean coin. That bond still holds. I fly with you.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: You never bought me, Ice-king.|That is why I will fly with you.
lines.text: You never bought me, Ice-king. That is why I will fly with you.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: And you sheltered the Outwall when|nobody paid. I remember debts.
lines.text: And you sheltered the Outwall when nobody paid. I remember debts.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Torvald? You're fighting HIM? ...Fine.|Aurivane stands down. Don't make me regret it.
lines.text: Torvald? You're fighting HIM? ...Fine. Aurivane stands down. Don't make me regret it.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Kesh. Morrow. Sunwake. I filled|your hoards to the brim. Earn them.
lines.text: Kesh. Morrow. Sunwake. I filled your hoards to the brim. Earn them.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: My lord, the Bazaar. A dragon serves whoever|filled the hoard last. Pay them to fly away.
lines.text: My lord, the Bazaar. A dragon serves whoever filled the hoard last. Pay them to fly away.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Paid to go home. The one price he never tried.
lines.text: Paid to go home. The one price he never tried.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: There is always another night,|Ice-king. Tonight it is yours.
lines.text: There is always another night, Ice-king. Tonight it is yours.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then I will spend it awake.
lines.text: Then I will spend it awake.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Those oars were ours! Nobody from|the Outwall rows for the candle-man!
lines.text: Those oars were ours! Nobody from the Outwall rows for the candle-man!

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Silver sinks the same as crimson,|my lord. Slower, perhaps. Heavier pride.
lines.text: Silver sinks the same as crimson, my lord. Slower, perhaps. Heavier pride.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: More, Bishop. The sea is generous tonight.
lines.text: More, Bishop. The sea is generous tonight.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Do you hear it, Torvald? Every one of|them is mine now. Every single one.
lines.text: Do you hear it, Torvald? Every one of them is mine now. Every single one.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He walked out once, and the sea went still.|Your turn, Ice-king. Go to the light.
lines.text: He walked out once, and the sea went still. Your turn, Ice-king. Go to the light.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The west water is glass.|Their galleys are stuck fast.
lines.text: The west water is glass. Their galleys are stuck fast.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The east is frozen! Dacian, back to back!
lines.text: The east is frozen! Dacian, back to back!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Torvald! You never said no to anyone|in your life. Why start with me?
lines.text: Torvald! You never said no to anyone in your life. Why start with me?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Because I finally saw what you were buying.
lines.text: Because I finally saw what you were buying.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Enough.
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: I have heard that word once before.|It sounded better from you.
lines.text: I have heard that word once before. It sounded better from you.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The sea... was never mine to hold.
lines.text: The sea... was never mine to hold.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The rock is his. The stone will|drink the whole strait now.
lines.text: The rock is his. The stone will drink the whole strait now.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: The Bishop sends his regrets.|I will deliver them in person, later.
lines.text: The Bishop sends his regrets. I will deliver them in person, later.
